description: (Na)₂NaErCl₆ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaErCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaErCl₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ErCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.70 Å. Er is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form ErCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Er-Cl bond lengths are 2.59 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Er atom.
